notes.title: Update on July 25
notes.content:
[h1]Xpraize Beta for GameMaster update[/h1]


[olist]
[h3][*]Combat improvements[/h3]
Various improvements have been made, such as granting NPCs weapon attack detection only when attacking, and playing a sound depending on the weapon when NPCs attack.
[h3][*]Creation of options[/h3]
An options screen has been created that allows the user to adjust the volume, exit the game, switch between windowed and full screen, and change the resolution.
[/olist]

notes.title: Update 06/17/2022
notes.content:
[b]This update is mainly for the VR version, but the PC version also includes minor adjustments.[/b]

1. Added a function to adjust the position of the character using a mirror when selecting the character at the beginning of the game
2. Adjusted the display position of various UI.
3. Fixed a bug that prevented the ED from playing.
Fixed a synchronization bug when other players joined in the middle of the game.
